mkdir -p build && cat > report.py <<'EOF'
"""Build build/batching.json for seeds 0-9 (modeled ms)."""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from run import arrivals, experiment


def build():
    runs = []
    for seed in range(10):
        res = experiment(seed)
        for w in ("sparse", "burst"):
            n = len(arrivals(seed, w))
            s1, s16 = res[w]["1"], res[w]["16"]
            assert s1["count"] == s16["count"] == n
            runs.append({"seed": seed, "workload": w, "samples": n,
                         "size_1": s1, "size_16": s16,
                         "mean_delta_ms": s16["mean_ms"] - s1["mean_ms"],
                         "batch16_lower_mean": s16["mean_ms"] < s1["mean_ms"]})
    summ = {}
    for w in ("sparse", "burst"):
        rs = [r for r in runs if r["workload"] == w]
        summ[w] = {"samples_per_run": sorted({r["samples"] for r in rs}),
                   "mean_ms_size_1": sum(r["size_1"]["mean_ms"] for r in rs) / len(rs),
                   "mean_ms_size_16": sum(r["size_16"]["mean_ms"] for r in rs) / len(rs),
                   "seeds_batch16_lower": sum(r["batch16_lower_mean"] for r in rs)}
    return runs, summ


if __name__ == "__main__":
    runs, summ = build()
    json.dump({"runs": runs, "summary": summ, "conclusion": "TBD"}, sys.stdout, indent=1)
